```{=typst}
#let mk(n) = box(baseline: 22%, circle(radius: 5.8pt, fill: rgb("#d9480f"), stroke: none, inset: 0pt)[#set align(center + horizon); #text(fill: white, weight: "bold", size: 8pt)[#n]])
#let tick = box(baseline: 12%, width: 10pt, height: 10pt, stroke: 0.9pt + luma(70), radius: 2pt)
#let shot(path, w: 100%) = block(breakable: false, stroke: 0.8pt + luma(150), radius: 6pt, clip: true, image(path, width: w))
#let typebox(body) = block(width: 100%, breakable: false, fill: rgb("#f1f6fd"), stroke: 0.8pt + rgb("#185abd"), radius: 5pt, inset: (x: 12pt, y: 9pt), body)
#let tip(body) = block(width: 100%, breakable: false, fill: rgb("#fff4e6"), stroke: (left: 3pt + rgb("#d9480f")), inset: (x: 10pt, y: 7pt), radius: 3pt, body)
// One step: the box to tick, its number and what to do on the left; its screen on the right.
#let step(n, body, img: none, w: 100%, left: 40%, after: none) = block(breakable: false, above: 9pt, below: 9pt, width: 100%)[
  #set par(justify: false, leading: 0.62em)
  #let words = grid(columns: (auto, 1fr), column-gutter: 6pt, [#tick #h(1pt) *#n.*], body)
  #if img == none { words } else {
    grid(columns: (left, 1fr), column-gutter: 12pt, align: (top, top), words, align(center, shot(img, w: w)))
  }
  #if after != none { v(4pt); after }
]
```

::: {.lead}
Today you make a small website for Mona's Cakes in **Google Sites**, and a first web page in **Notepad**. Do the tasks in order. The **orange
numbers** in each picture show where to click. Tick the box `#tick`{=typst} after each step. Stuck? Raise your hand.
:::

- **You need:** a lab computer with Google Sites. **Nothing to download:**
  you type the text yourself.
- **Time:** about 35 minutes. Your Google Sites may look a little different:
  the names of the buttons are the same.

## Task 1 · A new site

```{=typst}
#step(1, [Open the browser. Go to *sites.google.com*. Sign in with your *Google account*. \ Click *Blank site* #mk(1).], img: "images/lab-sites-1.png", w: 92%, left: 34%)
#step(2, [Click *Untitled site* (top left) #mk(1) and type: #h(2pt) #box(fill: white, stroke: 0.6pt + rgb("#185abd"), radius: 4pt, inset: 4pt)[Mona's Cakes] \ Click *Your page title* #mk(2) and type: #h(2pt) #box(fill: white, stroke: 0.6pt + rgb("#185abd"), radius: 4pt, inset: 4pt)[Mona's Cakes]], img: "images/lab-sites-2.png", w: 100%, left: 38%)
```

## Task 2 · Two more pages

```{=typst}
#step(1, [On the right, click *Pages* #mk(1). Click *+ New page* #mk(2). \ Type the name *Cakes* #mk(3). Click *Done* #mk(4). \ Then one more page: *Order*. \ The menu at the top has the links #mk(5).], after: align(center, shot("images/lab-sites-3.png", w: 92%)))
```

```{=typst}

#step(2, [Click *Phone* #mk(1): the menu becomes ☰ #mk(2). \ Click *Large screen*, then close the preview (X at the top).], img: "images/lab-sites-5.png", w: 60%, left: 40%)
```

## Task 4 · A web page in Notepad

```{=typst}
#step(1, [Click *Search*, type *notepad*, open *Notepad*. Type these six lines exactly:], after: [#v(2pt) #box(fill: white, stroke: 0.6pt + rgb("#185abd"), radius: 4pt, inset: 7pt, raw(block: true, "<html>\n<body style=\"font-family: Arial\">\n<h1 style=\"color: brown\">Mona's Cakes</h1>\n<p>Fresh cakes, made at home.</p>\n</body>\n</html>"))])
#step(2, [*File › Save as*. Click *Desktop* #mk(1). \ *File name*: *page-* and your first name *.html*, for example *page-Huda.html* #mk(2). \ *Save as type*: *All files*. Click *Save* #mk(3).], img: "images/lab-save-1.png", w: 94%, left: 34%)
#step(3, [On the Desktop, double-click *page-….html*: the page opens in the browser, with a brown heading. \ In Notepad, change *brown* to *green*. Press *Ctrl + S*. In the browser, press *F5*: the heading is green.])
```

## Extra · AI adds a paragraph to your web page

```{=typst}
#block(width: 100%, fill: rgb("#e3f4f1"), stroke: 0.8pt + rgb("#8fd1c4"), radius: 6pt, inset: (x: 12pt, y: 9pt))[
  Only when you finish Tasks 1–4. On *tutudocs.com* an *AI assistant* changes your web page for you. *No sign-in.*
]
#step(1, [Open the browser. Go to *tutudocs.com*.])
#step(2, [Click the box *Drop a file anywhere on this page, or click to choose* #mk(1). \ Click *Desktop*, click your file *page-….html*, click *Open*. \ Your web page opens in the online editor.], img: "images/lab-tutu-1.png", w: 84%, left: 36%)
#step(3, [Click *AI Assistant* at the top #mk(1). \ Click in *Ask AI anything…* #mk(2) and type: #h(3pt) #box(fill: white, stroke: 0.6pt + rgb("#8fd1c4"), radius: 4pt, inset: 5pt)[Add a short paragraph: our three cakes are chocolate, strawberry and vanilla.] \ Press *Enter* #mk(3). Wait about 15 seconds: a new paragraph comes.], after: align(center, shot("images/lab-tutu-2.png", w: 84%)))
#step(4, [One more request. Type: #h(3pt) #box(fill: white, stroke: 0.6pt + rgb("#8fd1c4"), radius: 4pt, inset: 5pt)[Make the heading green.] \ Press *Enter*. Wait for the answer before you type again.])
#step(5, [Click *File* #mk(1), then *Download* #mk(2), then *HTML* #mk(3). \ Open the new file from *Downloads*: it opens in the browser, with the changes of the AI.], img: "images/lab-tutu-3.png", w: 74%, left: 44%)
```
